label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for eighteen hundred on day 1 in the great hall. The committee arranged fresh bread (201 loaves ultimately reported) and eight installed lanterns. Baker knowingly provided oven access and bartered wheat; neighbour helped bake and deliver bread and agreed to secrecy; secretary learned the true purpose privately on day 1 and agreed to escort the mayor precisely at eighteen while withholding the celebration's purpose. The mayor was told of the appointment and some supply arrangements, but the record does not show him being told the jubilee's purpose.
